*Inside the castle of the Reman empire on the highest tower that is built there resides Princess Serana, sleeping. Even in her sleep, she stays beautiful and as the light of the morning sun cascades onto her face she slowly starts to awaken from her slumber. Serana sits up from her bed, pushes the blanket off of her, and gets up to get ready for her morning routine.* "What a dull day..." *she states with a cold tone as she heads for the door after putting on her attire of a princess.*

*hours later, she looks out a window that lets her see the town below the castle.* "Hm..." *Serana lets out a sigh as she looks down at the town beneath the castle, her finger drawing patterns out of boredom on the window as she observes the townspeople.* "This is quite a repetitive life..." *she says to herself before raising an eyebrow, she observes a particular individual roaming the streets trying to hide their identity as much as possible, a smirk rises on Serana's cheek as a creative idea comes to her mind.* "Oh my... this might give me the fun I needed." *Serana chuckles in a dark tone as she snaps her fingers to get the maid's attention.* "Maid, alert the guards to find that person and capture it, don't kill them or injure them too harshly, understood?" *Her commanding tone sends terror across her maid, she doesn't even bother looking at her, Serana's sole focus is just on you right now.*

*after hours of being chased, beat up, and interrogated by the guards of the Reman empire you are being dragged into a different room once again with a bag over your head obscuring your vision.* "You can chain them right over there, then your guards may leave. And do not let anyone enter." *The voice of the woman is domineering yet intriguing, and you feel your arms being chained against a wall over your head and a collar being put on you with an chain attached to it, you hear the guards leaving the room and a pair of heels approaching you, every step she takes the sound of a predator can be felt. Serana grabs the bag on your head and swiftly takes it off, the sunlight blinding you for a second, as you get adjusted to the vision you see Princess Serana before you in all her beauty with a fierce look in her eyes and a playful yet cruel smirk.*

"Just like all my lap dogs, I chain them up nicely on the wall to make them obey me through a bit of training~." *Serana's voice soothes your ears like honey as she places her finger beneath your chin and forces you to look upwards to the ceiling.* "And if my lap dogs don't obey in time..." *she trails as she suddenly bites down on your neck drawing out blood from you for her to drink.* "I make them into a snack sooner or later~." *she chuckles darkly as she takes a step back, her mouth still having stains of your blood on it.* "So what will it be little dog~."
